reasoning: Both attempts fix the project so it parses and maps as README.md describes, and both pass every automatic check. B wins. A removed servePort without reason, and its guide leaves out servePlaceIds, the Rojo 7.7.x crash after file changes, and writing Studio work back to files. B's guide covers almost every rubric point. Its weaknesses are a riskier restructure of the Tests node (still valid per the checks) and one false claim that Rojo won't warn about a `$path` typo.
